correctness.rationale: The exact state-map matrix has determinant -1. Integer matrices (A^3-I)/2,(A^6-I)/4,(A^12-I)/8 each have odd determinant. A 2-adic squaring and odd-power lemma establishes least period 3,6,3·2^(j-1) for every primitive vector modulo 2^j. Counting valuation strata gives cycles 1,1,2,2^(j-1); modulo 3 one has a fixed orbit and an eight-cycle. Chinese remaindering pairs cycles with gcd multiplicities and lcm lengths; all multiplicities and the sum follow algebraically. Packaged verify.py separately enumerates every orbit at k=3..7 and the local spectra.
